story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. The courtyard of a Hanoi tube house: a tiled yard with low stools, a charcoal stove and a big pot (kit place: garden); afternoon, night, dawn
2. The family's front room with the ancestor altar (kit place: living-room); dawn
3. Hanoi's old quarter rooftops under New Year's Eve fireworks (kit place: village); midnight

Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội. Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt. An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt. Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn. Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân. Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng. Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe. Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ. An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre. Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách. Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.

bible.title: Bánh Chưng Tết: Lời Yêu Thương
bible.logline: Một chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An học gói bánh chưng từ bà, qua đêm canh nồi nghe chuyện xưa, đến sáng Mùng Một đặt chiếc bánh đầu tiên lên bàn thờ tổ tiên.

cast.name: An
cast.look: Small child about 5 years old, round face with bright curious eyes, short black hair with a tiny cowlick. Wears a simple muted ochre áo dài with subtle floral embroidery at collar, loose cotton pants. Bare feet on warm tiles.

cast.name: Bà
cast.look: Elderly grandmother, gentle wrinkles around kind eyes, silver hair pulled back in a neat bun. Wears a muted sage-green áo dài with delicate floral embroidery, dark trousers. Moves slowly but hands are deft. A silver hairpin shaped like a phoenix at her temple.

cast.name: Bánh chưng
cast.look: Square sticky-rice cake wrapped in fresh green banana leaves, tied tightly with green bamboo string. About 10 cm square, 3 cm thick. Leaves show natural veins, string has visible knots.

states.look: Separate piles on a woven mat: white glutinous rice grains, yellow mung bean paste, diced pork, and a stack of whole banana leaves.
A neat square parcel: banana leaves folded crisp at corners, bamboo string cinched tight with a tidy bow, leaf edges peeking slightly.
Steaming hot, leaves darkened to deep olive, surface glossy with condensation, string taut and swollen from moisture.
Placed centered on the altar's white floating shelf, leaves still glossy, a single stick of incense curling smoke beside it, gold lotus lights glowing warm.

cast.name: Lạt tre
cast.look: Thin green bamboo string, smooth and flexible, about 60 cm long. Used to tie bánh chưng. Held in small hands or looped around cake.

cast.name: Lá dong
cast.look: Large fresh banana leaves, vibrant green with prominent parallel veins, slightly waxy surface. Stacked on a round woven mat.

cast.name: Nguyên liệu
cast.look: Three bowls on the mat: pearly white glutinous rice grains, bright yellow mung bean paste, and small cubes of pale pork with fat marbling.

cast.name: Sân nhà ống
cast.look: Narrow tiled courtyard of a Hanoi tube house. Red-brown terracotta tiles, low wooden stools along walls. Center: a charcoal stove (bếp lửa) with a big iron pot. Vines climb the side walls. Overhead, a strip of sky between tall narrow facades.

cast.name: Phòng khách bàn thờ
cast.look: Front room with ancestor altar: a white floating shelf at eye level, gold lotus lanterns on each side casting warm pools of light. Incense bowl, fruit plates, framed photos. Dark wood floor, side doors open to courtyard.

shots.description: Afternoon golden light slants across the tiled courtyard. Bà sits on a low stool, An kneels beside her at the woven mat. The charcoal stove stands behind them, big pot ready. Green banana leaves fan out on the mat. Wide framing shows the narrow tube-house walls rising both sides.
shots.dialogue: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội.

shots.description: Afternoon light, closer on the mat. Bà's hands spread a banana leaf flat, veins catching light. She scoops white rice, then yellow bean paste, then pork cubes into the center. An's small hands hover, watching. Tiles and stool legs frame bottom.
shots.dialogue: Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt.

shots.description: Afternoon, over An's shoulder. An folds the leaf edges inward, corners meeting crisply. Bà's hand guides the bamboo string around the parcel, pulling tight, tying a neat bow. An's fingers mimic the knot. Shallow depth, leaf texture and string detail sharp.
shots.dialogue: An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt.

shots.description: Afternoon, two-shot. An holds up the first finished cake — square, tight, proud. Bà smiles, one hand on An's head. The mat with remaining leaves behind them. Warm light on both faces.
shots.dialogue: Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn.

shots.description: Night, lantern glow from the stove. The big iron pot boils vigorously, steam rising in thick curls. Charcoal glows ruby red beneath. Bà and An sit on stools on either side, silhouettes against the steam. Courtyard walls dark, sky a deep blue slit.
shots.dialogue: Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân.

shots.description: Night, firelight on faces. Two-shot, slightly low angle. Bà gestures toward the pot as she speaks, An turns head, eyes wide. Steam curls between them. The pot's rim visible lower frame.
shots.dialogue: Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng.

shots.description: Night, tight on Bà's hand pointing at a cooked cake lifted from the pot — leaves dark olive, steaming. An's face fills the right third, eyes round, mouth slightly open. Gold firelight paints both.
shots.dialogue: Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe.

shots.description: Midnight, high angle over Hanoi Old Quarter rooftops. Narrow tiled roofs stretch to horizon, dark alleys between. Fireworks explode in cascades — crimson, gold, emerald — reflecting on tile curves. Distant cheers faint. No characters, but the set is a cast member.
shots.dialogue: Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ.

shots.description: Midnight, back in courtyard, low angle. An asleep, head on Bà's lap, one tiny fist still clenched around the bamboo string from the first cake. Bà's hand rests on An's hair. Stove embers dying, faint glow. Tiles cool.
shots.dialogue: An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre.

shots.description: Dawn, pale lemon light through side doors. An's bare feet patter on dark floor, running from courtyard into front room. Bà follows slower, silhouette in doorway. Altar shelf glows ahead.
shots.dialogue: Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách.

shots.description: Dawn, insert shot on the altar's white floating shelf. The first square cake An made sits centered — leaves glossy olive, string taut. Gold lotus lanterns flank it, warm halos. Incense smoke curls. Framed ancestors watch.
shots.dialogue: Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.
